info.title: Loupe API v1
info.description: The public HTTP API of Loupe.

200.description: The public v1 specification, as JSON.

get.summary: List the columns and card types of the board
get.description: The columns read in board order, so this list takes no `sort`. The answer also carries the card types, which `board_columns` returns beside the columns.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most rows to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The opaque position from the `next` URL of the last page.

200.description: One page of columns, with the card types.

post.summary: Add a column to the board
post.description: `Location` names the new column by its slug. No route reads one column, so read it from the list.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your choice. A retry with the same key and body answers as the first request did. The same key with another body gets 409 `idempotency_key_reused`.

201.description: The new column, and every column of the board.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: The slug of a column, from the column list.

delete.description: A moved card follows the rules of a move. Nobody can delete Backlog, and a board keeps at least one terminal column.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: The slug of a column, from the column list.

parameters.name: targetColumn
parameters.description: The slug of the column the cards move to. It is needed only when the column holds cards.

200.description: The deleted slug, the moved cards, and every column that remains.

patch.summary: Rename a column, or set whether it is terminal

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: The slug of a column, from the column list.

200.description: The column after the change, and every column of the board.

put.summary: Put the columns in a new order
put.description: Backlog always comes first and never moves, so leave it out. `errors[].code` is `backlog_in_order`, `unknown_column` or `order_incomplete`.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

200.description: Every column, in the new order.

get.summary: List the API versions of this instance
List the projects this credential reaches

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most rows to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The opaque position from the `next` URL of the last page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort order. The default is creation order, oldest first. A leading `-` sorts newest first.

post.description: The credential must cover every project of its owner. The search language starts at the instance default. PATCH sets `description` and `searchLanguage`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your choice. A retry with the same key and body answers as the first request did. The same key with another body gets 409 `idempotency_key_reused`.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

patch.description: A new name changes the slug, so a reference to the old slug, such as a bridge rule file, stops matching.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

put.summary: Record the answer of the owner to a decision
put.description: Call this only after the owner gave the answer. A newer version than `versionNumber` is refused. A bridge worker is refused.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

parameters.name: decision
parameters.description: The id that the document declared in the fence of the decision block.

delete.summary: Clear the chosen options of a decision
delete.description: The note of the owner stays. A bridge worker is refused.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

parameters.name: decision
parameters.description: The id that the document declared in the fence of the decision block.

parameters.name: versionNumber
parameters.description: The version you showed the owner. A newer version is refused.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most rows to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The opaque position from the `next` URL of the last page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort order. The default is creation order, oldest first. A leading `-` sorts newest first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Terms matched against the title and the current content, anywhere inside a word and ignoring case. Quotes, a leading minus and `or` work. With `q` and no `sort`, a document with every word in the title comes first, and each group reads oldest first.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only documents in this state.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only documents with this tag, ignoring case and surrounding spaces.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Only documents in this series, ignoring case. With no `sort`, they read by their position.

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: Include archived rows, which are left out by default.

post.description: Unlike a read, the answer also holds `reviewUrl`, the review page in the app. `Location` names the new document.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your choice. A retry with the same key and body answers as the first request did. The same key with another body gets 409 `idempotency_key_reused`.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most rows to return.

parameters.name: sort

post.summary: Submit a revision of a document
post.description: Open comments are re-anchored onto the new version. Those whose quoted text no longer appears are flagged orphaned. `Location` names the new version.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your choice. A retry with the same key and body answers as the first request did. The same key with another body gets 409 `idempotency_key_reused`.

201.description: The new version, with the comment counts.

patch.description: Take the root comment of a thread on the current version. A reply gets 422, with `errors[].code` `comment_is_reply`. A thread that is already addressed answers 200, and nothing changes.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: The id of a comment from the review, on the current version of the document.

post.summary: Send a draft document to review
post.description: A document that is not a draft comes back unchanged, with `published` false. No version is created.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

post.description: Take a comment id from the current review. A revision makes new comment rows, so reply before you revise, or read the review again after it. `Location` points at the review, because no route reads one comment.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: The id of a comment from the review, on the current version of the document.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your choice. A retry with the same key and body answers as the first request did. The same key with another body gets 409 `idempotency_key_reused`.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

200.description: The document, with its current Markdown.

patch.summary: Change the metadata of a document
patch.description: The server checks every field before it writes one, so a field it refuses changes nothing. Use `POST .../versions` to change the Markdown.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version number of the document, counting from 1.

get.summary: Read the review of the current version

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

post.summary: Record the verdict of the owner
post.description: An approval moves the card of the document on. A verdict on a draft stops its agent review. A bridge worker is refused.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

delete.summary: Withdraw the newest verdict for the owner
delete.description: Call this only after the owner asked for it. A bridge worker is refused.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: A project id or a project slug. A slug changes when the project is renamed, so quote the id when it must stay valid.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: The document id.

parameters.name: verdict
parameters.description: The `verdictId` from the review. A newer verdict is refused.

parameters.name: versionNumber
parameters.description: The version you showed the owner. A newer version is refused.

slug.description: Null on a project created before the slug existed, so quote the id.

domain.description: The domain of the site the project reviews.

allowedOrigins.description: The site origins the sign-in widget may run on.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

ProjectCreate.description: Give a name, a remote, or both.

name.description: The project name. With no name, the project takes the last path segment of `remote`.

origins.description: The origins to allow. An entry is an origin with no path, or a wildcard of one label. Plain http works on localhost only.

ProjectUpdate.description: A field you leave out keeps its value.

name.description: A new name. It also changes the slug.

origins.description: Replaces the whole stored list, and an empty list clears it. At most 20 entries and 4000 characters together, with no line break in an entry.

label.description: The name a person sees on the board.

terminal.description: A terminal column is where finished work goes.

default.description: True for the column where a new card lands when you pass no status.

backlog.description: True for Backlog, which the board does not draw as a column.

children.description: A card of this type may be the parent of other cards.

lane.description: A card of this type gets a lane on the board.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

types.description: The card types of the project.

defaultType.description: The type a new card gets.

column.description: The slug of the column after the change.

columns.description: Every column of the board, in board order.
Every column of the board, in the new order.

label.description: The slug comes from the label. The new column goes last, and it is not terminal.

ColumnUpdate.description: A field you leave out keeps its value.

label.description: A new name. The slug changes with it, so a bridge rule or a script that uses the old slug stops working.

terminal.description: Whether finished work goes in this column.

order.description: The slug of every column except backlog, each once, from left to right.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

markdown.description: The Markdown source of the current version.

references.description: The documents this one points at. Only this direction is writable.

referencedBy.description: The documents that point at this one.

reviewUrl.description: The review page in the app.

published.description: False when the document was not a draft.

threadCount.description: The number of comment threads on this version.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

markdown.description: The Markdown source of this version.

versionNumber.description: The number of the new version.

carried.description: The open comments carried to the new version.

orphaned.description: The comments whose quoted text no longer appears.

markdown.description: At most 1048575 bytes. Write a card as `card:<number>` and a pull request as `pr:owner/repo#<number>`.

description.title: A blank description means none was given, but "0" is a description.
description.description: What this first version is, in one or two sentences.

tags.description: Lowercased on write and created on first use.

series.description: The ordered set this document is an item of. It needs `seriesOrdinal`.

seriesOrdinal.description: The position in that series, from 1. No two documents in one series hold the same number.

draft.description: Keep the document out of review and the inbox until `publish`.

DocumentUpdate.description: A field you leave out keeps its value. No version is created.

tags.description: The complete set, and an empty list clears it.

references.description: The complete set, and an empty list clears it. A document cannot reference itself.

series.description: The series name. Null with a null `seriesOrdinal` takes the document out of its series.

seriesOrdinal.description: The position in that series, from 1.

archived.description: True archives the document, and false restores it. Nothing is deleted and no version is created.

archiveReason.description: Why the document is archived. It is required with `archived: true`, and ignored otherwise.

markdown.description: The new Markdown. At most 1048575 bytes.

description.description: What changed and why, for a reviewer who read the previous version.

references.description: The complete set. Leave it out to keep it, and send an empty list to clear it.

series.description: Leave it out to keep the placement. An empty string takes the document out of its series.

author.description: The class of writer, not an identity.

quote.description: Widened to whole words, except on a comment with a replacement, where it is the verbatim span.

replacement.description: What the reviewer wants the quote to become. Null means no edit, and an empty string means delete the passage.

orphaned.description: The quote no longer appears in the document.

option.description: The option as it read when it was chosen.

index.description: The index in `options`, or null when it is no longer offered.

selected.description: For a single-choice block. Null on a multiple-choice block.

throughAgent.description: An agent recorded the answer for the owner.

throughApiKey.description: An API key recorded the answer for the owner.

verdict.description: The verdict standing on the current version. Null also after a withdrawal.

verdictId.description: The newest entry of the verdict log, a withdrawal included.

verdictThroughApiKey.description: An API key recorded the verdict for the owner.

status.description: The only status a route writes. Resolved stays with a person.

body.description: The reply text. At most 65536 bytes. The reply is attributed to the agent.

versionNumber.description: The version you showed the owner.

optionIndexes.description: The indexes of the options the owner chose, from 0.

note.description: The note of the owner. Leave it out to keep the stored note, and pass an empty string to remove it.

versionNumber.description: The version you showed the owner.

expectedVerdictId.description: The `verdictId` from the review. Pass null when that is null.

verdictId.description: The id of the withdrawal entry.

type.description: A URI that names the error.

title.description: A short summary of the error.

ValidationProblem.description: A refusal of one or more fields.

field.description: The field, as a request names it.

code.description: The stable code of the refusal.

NameTakenProblem.description: A refusal because a name is taken.

slug.description: The slug of the project that holds the name.

ApiVersions.description: The API versions of this instance.

cliRange.description: The CLI versions this server works with, as a caret range.

Retry-After.description: The number of seconds to wait before the next request.

RateLimit-Limit.description: The number of requests the window allows.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests left in the window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: The seconds until the window resets.

Link.description: The next page, as `<url>; rel="next"`. It is absent on the last page.

Location.description: The URL of the new resource.

bearerAuth.description: An API key or an OAuth access token, in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
